title: Could be better.
text:
Would be 5 stars for me, but features aren’t as rich on the Mac OS version.

I would expect a little more from Apple, but I blame managements resource management and not the software developers. 

Please make it the same quality of application on Mac OS. App the mood tracking like on IOS. 

Make it a complete and finished product. Furthermore, export features, organization features should exist. Maybe 3rd person support - I’ll explain. 

Make it so you can have journal dedicated to someone else and shareable with them. (Like the notes app.) Make PDF’s attachable maybe, but that’s going a little far. 

There a lot to make it better, but at the very least keep it the same on IOS and MacOS.

title: No tags
text: There doesn’t seem to be an ability to put tags on these entries as there are other Apple products.

title: Great app
text: It is great to journal your thoughts and opinions with no one to judge you or your ideas.

title: Not built for Apple Pencil
text: The lack of thought for those that wish to use their Apple Pencils is astounding. No option to add grid lines? It doesn’t track handwritten notes as “words written this month.” The input lag is annoying…and the app frequently deletes entire sections of handwritten entries. Do better Apple!
